_registration_notes: CHANGING THE EVENT SHAPE: this file is the single source of truth for every service. When you add, remove or retype a field you must (1) update event.fields and event.required here, (2) update the field table and the example in contract/OD_INTERFACE.md, (3) extend the DDL in db/init.sql, and (4) if the field is required or changes type/range, update the json_schema block below. Ingest validates every payload against json_schema and drops anything that fails, so a field added to the prose but not to json_schema will be accepted-but-ignored, and a field added to json_schema without a DB column will break the insert at runtime, not at build time.
_json_schema_notes: json_schema is the machine-checkable half of this contract and is what ingest/app/contract.py hands to the jsonschema library. The prose in event.fields is for humans and is never parsed. Two deliberate choices: additionalProperties is true because OD_INTERFACE.md rule 5 says unknown keys are preserved rather than rejected, and timestamp is a pattern rather than format:date-time because jsonschema only checks date-time when an optional format library is installed, and a silently-unenforced format is worse than an explicit regex.

fields.plate_string: string, vehicle registration as read by the detector
fields.camera_id: string, must equal the {camera_id} segment of the topic
fields.timestamp: ISO8601, UTC, moment of the sighting
fields.image_ref: string | null, optional, opaque reference to the captured frame
fields.direction: string | null, optional, enum: N | S | E | W | NE | NW | SE | SW
fields.lane: int | null, optional, lane number within the camera's field of view
fields.vehicle_type: string | null, optional, enum: car | bike | truck | bus. Null means the detector could not classify the vehicle; it is never guessed downstream.

detection_to_ingest.scope: The upstream detection component is a black box. It is handed this JSON and nothing else, and is never asked for an event id, a storage handle or a rendering hint. It owns no downstream responsibility.
detection_to_ingest.delivery: one MQTT PUBLISH per sighting to anpr/{camera_id}/sightings at QoS 1, payload = the event object verbatim

fields.direction: N | S | E | W | NE | NW | SE | SW | null (optional)
fields.vehicle_type: car | bike | truck | bus | null (optional, detector-supplied; never inferred downstream)
